title: features.json — the module's feature list (authored, never derived)
description: The feature spine: every id is referenced by at least one child <child>.md §5 SourceFeature (enforced by check-coverage), and the simulation-plan agent derives testpoints and tests from these entries. Authored by the specification stage's Wave 1; design.md §1.3 points here and carries no table. Values are free prose — no script parses inside a field. Every field except coverage_intent is required and non-empty: a blank one is a defect, not a default.

id.description: The feature identifier child §5 SourceFeature rows and testpoints refer to.

name.description: Short label. Reaches the TB testlist and the human-read case-results summary.

description.description: What the feature is, including any RTL formula that pins it.

mode_interface.description: The interface group or operating mode this feature exercises.

priority.description: Free text — the vocabulary is the project's, not this schema's.

negative_cases.description: Behaviour on invalid or out-of-contract stimulus.

coverage_intent.description: Optional coverage goal. Absent means absent; nothing substitutes a value.
